response.bodyText:
# Cloudflare Developer Documentation

Explore guides and tutorials to start building on Cloudflare's platform.

> Each product below links to its own llms.txt, which contains a full index of that product's documentation pages and is the recommended way to explore a specific product's content.

## Application performance

- [Argo Smart Routing](https://developers.cloudflare.com/argo-smart-routing/llms.txt): Route web traffic across the fastest, most reliable network paths
- [Automatic Platform Optimization](https://developers.cloudflare.com/automatic-platform-optimization/llms.txt): Improve WordPress site performance by serving it from Cloudflare's global network
- [Cache / CDN](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cache/llms.txt): Make websites faster by caching content across our global server network
- [China Network](https://developers.cloudflare.com/china-network/llms.txt): Fast, global network serving visitors inside and outside of China
- [Cloudflare Web Analytics](https://developers.cloudflare.com/web-analytics/llms.txt): Get vital web analytics for your website
- [DNS](https://developers.cloudflare.com/dns/llms.txt): Deliver excellent performance and reliability to your domain
- [Google tag gateway for advertisers](https://developers.cloudflare.com/google-tag-gateway/llms.txt): Add a layer of data security and privacy controls when using Google Tag Manager
- [Health Checks](https://developers.cloudflare.com/health-checks/llms.txt): Monitor IPs or hostnames and get notified of issues
- [Load Balancing](https://developers.cloudflare.com/load-balancing/llms.txt): Maximize application performance and availability
- [Smart Shield](https://developers.cloudflare.com/smart-shield/llms.txt): Safeguard your origin with just a few clicks.
- [Spectrum](https://developers.cloudflare.com/spectrum/llms.txt): Secure and accelerate any TCP or UDP-based application
- [Speed](https://developers.cloudflare.com/speed/llms.txt): Improve the performance of your website or web application
- [SSL/TLS](https://developers.cloudflare.com/ssl/llms.txt): Encrypt your web traffic to prevent data theft and other tampering
- [Waiting Room](https://developers.cloudflare.com/waiting-room/llms.txt): Create a virtual waiting room to manage peak traffic
- [Web3](https://developers.cloudflare.com/web3/llms.txt): Gateways to networks to help you develop applications without worrying about running infrastructure

## Application security

- [API Shield](https://developers.cloudflare.com/api-shield/llms.txt): Identify and address your API vulnerabilities
- [Bots](https://developers.cloudflare.com/bots/llms.txt): Protect your domain from bad bot traffic
- [Challenges](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-challenges/llms.txt): Verify visitors are not bots with lightweight challenges
- [Client-side security](https://developers.cloudflare.com/client-side-security/llms.txt): Provide client-side protection for your website visitors
- [DDoS Protection](https://developers.cloudflare.com/ddos-protection/llms.txt): Protect against DDoS attacks automatically with uncompromised performance
- [DMARC Management](https://developers.cloudflare.com/dmarc-management/llms.txt): Protect your email domain and stop brand impersonation
- [Firewall Rules (deprecated)](https://developers.cloudflare.com/firewall/llms.txt): Create rules that examine incoming HTTP traffic against a set of powerful filters to block, challenge, log, or allow matching requests. Firewall Rules have been replaced with WAF custom rules.
- [Key Transparency Auditor](https://developers.cloudflare.com/key-transparency/llms.txt): Secure the distribution of public keys in E2EE messaging systems
- [Secrets Store](https://developers.cloudflare.com/secrets-store/llms.txt): Encrypt and store sensitive information as secrets that are securely reusable across an account
- [Security Center](https://developers.cloudflare.com/security-center/llms.txt): Enhance your security posture with a range of security products and one-click solutions
- [Turnstile](https://developers.cloudflare.com/turnstile/llms.txt): Turnstile is Cloudflare's smart CAPTCHA alternative
- [WAF](https://developers.cloudflare.com/waf/llms.txt): Filter incoming traffic and protect against web app vulnerabilities

## Cloudflare One

- [Cloudflare Mesh](https://developers.cloudflare.com/mesh/llms.txt): Connect services and devices with post-quantum encrypted mesh networking
- [Cloudflare Network Firewall](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-network-firewall/llms.txt): Protect your enterprise network with advanced firewall-as-a-service protection
- [Cloudflare One](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/llms.txt): Replace legacy security perimeters with Cloudflare's network to protect your organization
- [Cloudflare WAN](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-wan/llms.txt): Replace legacy WAN and securely connect any traffic source to Cloudflare's network
- [Data Localization Suite](https://developers.cloudflare.com/data-localization/llms.txt): Control where Cloudflare stores and inspects data

## Consumer services

- [1.1.1.1 (DNS Resolver)](https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/llms.txt): A blazing fast DNS resolver built for private browsing
- [Radar](https://developers.cloudflare.com/radar/llms.txt): Investigate Internet usage around the world using Cloudflare's data
- [WARP Client](https://developers.cloudflare.com/warp-client/llms.txt): Allows individuals or organizations to have a faster, more secure connection to the Internet

## Core platform

- [AI Crawl Control](https://developers.cloudflare.com/ai-crawl-control/llms.txt): Analyze and control third-party AI crawlers in your website
- [Analytics](https://developers.cloudflare.com/analytics/llms.txt): Visualize the performance, security, and reliability data collected by Cloudflare products
- [Billing](https://developers.cloudflare.com/billing/llms.txt): Manage billing, plans, and subscriptions for your account
- [Cloudflare CLI](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cf/llms.txt): Manage Cloudflare resources from one command-line interface
- [Cloudflare Fundamentals](https://developers.cloudflare.com/fundamentals/llms.txt): Learn about using Cloudflare and features that span across Cloudflare products
- [Cloudflare Observability](https://developers.cloudflare.com/observability/llms.txt): Find Cloudflare documentation for logs, traces, analytics, alerts, telemetry export, and dashboards
- [Cloudflare Tunnel](https://developers.cloudflare.com/tunnel/llms.txt): Connect your origin servers, APIs, and services to Cloudflare without a publicly routable IP address
- [Logs](https://developers.cloudflare.com/logs/llms.txt): Access detailed logs with metadata from Cloudflare products
- [Monetization Gateway](https://developers.cloudflare.com/monetization-gateway/llms.txt): Define monetization policies to charge any visitor accessing APIs, MCP tools, web pages, or datasets.
- [Network](https://developers.cloudflare.com/network/llms.txt): Manage Cloudflare network settings for your website
- [Notifications](https://developers.cloudflare.com/notifications/llms.txt): Define what you want to be notified about and how
- [Pulumi](https://developers.cloudflare.com/pulumi/llms.txt): Create, deploy, and manage Cloudflare resources in various programming languages
- [Randomness Beacon](https://developers.cloudflare.com/randomness-beacon/llms.txt): Explore drand, a distributed service providing randomness to applications
- [Reference Architecture](https://developers.cloudflare.com/reference-architecture/llms.txt): Guides and diagrams explain Cloudflare products and how to integrate with IT architectures
- [Registrar](https://developers.cloudflare.com/registrar/llms.txt): Buy and renew your domain at cost, add another layer of security to your DNS records for free
- [Resource Tagging](https://developers.cloudflare.com/resource-tagging/llms.txt): Attach key-value metadata to Cloudflare resources for organization, access control, and billing attribution
- [Rules](https://developers.cloudflare.com/rules/llms.txt): Modify incoming requests, change Cloudflare settings, or trigger actions
- [Ruleset Engine](https://developers.cloudflare.com/ruleset-engine/llms.txt): Create rulesets and rules for different Cloudflare products
- [Support](https://developers.cloudflare.com/support/llms.txt): Cloudflare Support-focused documentation
- [Tenant](https://developers.cloudflare.com/tenant/llms.txt): Provision and manage Cloudflare accounts and services for your team or customers
- [Terraform](https://developers.cloudflare.com/terraform/llms.txt): Define and store Cloudflare configurations in source code repositories like GitHub
- [Time Services](https://developers.cloudflare.com/time-services/llms.txt): Cloudflare's suite of time services: NTP, NTS, and Roughtime
- [Version Management](https://developers.cloudflare.com/version-management/llms.txt): Safely manage configurations on Cloudflare's global network with versioning, staging, and rollbacks

## Developer platform

- [Agent Lee](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agent-lee/llms.txt): An AI co-pilot built into the Cloudflare dashboard that helps you navigate, configure, and take actions on Cloudflare services
- [Agent Memory](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agent-memory/llms.txt): Persistent AI-powered memory for agents and applications — automatically extract, classify, and recall knowledge from conversations
- [Agents](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/llms.txt): Build AI-powered agents to perform tasks, persist state, browse the web, and communicate in real-time
- [AI](https://developers.cloudflare.com/ai/llms.txt): Run AI models on Cloudflare's global network
- [AI Gateway](https://developers.cloudflare.com/ai-gateway/llms.txt): Observe and control your AI applications
- [AI Search](https://developers.cloudflare.com/ai-search/llms.txt): Create fully managed RAG pipelines for your AI applications
- [Artifacts](https://developers.cloudflare.com/artifacts/llms.txt): Store, version, and share filesystem artifacts across Workers, APIs, and git-compatible tools
- [Basin](https://developers.cloudflare.com/basin/llms.txt): Ingest, manage, and query analytics data stored in R2
- [Basin Catalog](https://developers.cloudflare.com/basin-catalog/llms.txt): Create, manage, and query Iceberg tables stored in R2
- [Basin Pipelines](https://developers.cloudflare.com/basin-pipelines/llms.txt): Ingest real time data streams and load into R2
- [Basin SQL](https://developers.cloudflare.com/basin-sql/llms.txt): Cloudflare's serverless, distributed query engine for data stored in Basin Catalog
- [Browser Run](https://developers.cloudflare.com/browser-run/llms.txt): Control and interact with headless browser instances programmatically
- [Cloudflare for Platforms](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-for-platforms/llms.txt): Build your own multi-tenant platform using Cloudflare as infrastructure
- [Cloudflare Images](https://developers.cloudflare.com/images/llms.txt): Store, transform, optimize, and deliver images at scale
- [Cloudflare OHTTP Relay](https://developers.cloudflare.com/ohttp-relay/llms.txt): Implement the Oblivious HTTP IETF standard to improve client privacy
- [Cloudflare Wallets](https://developers.cloudflare.com/wallets/llms.txt): Reserve a wallet handle and give your account and its agents a stable, human-readable identity for agentic payments
- [Containers](https://developers.cloudflare.com/containers/llms.txt): Enhance your Workers with serverless containers
- [D1](https://developers.cloudflare.com/d1/llms.txt): Create managed, serverless databases with SQL semantics
- [Durable Objects](https://developers.cloudflare.com/durable-objects/llms.txt): A special kind of Cloudflare Worker combining compute with storage
- [Dynamic Workers](https://developers.cloudflare.com/dynamic-workers/llms.txt): Spin up isolated Workers on demand to execute code
- [Email Service](https://developers.cloudflare.com/email-service/llms.txt): Send transactional emails at scale with Cloudflare Email Service
- [Flagship](https://developers.cloudflare.com/flagship/llms.txt): Feature flags evaluated at the edge for Cloudflare Workers
- [Hyperdrive](https://developers.cloudflare.com/hyperdrive/llms.txt): Accelerate database queries to make databases fast globally
- [K2](https://developers.cloudflare.com/k2/llms.txt): A durable event stream
- [KV](https://developers.cloudflare.com/kv/llms.txt): Global, low-latency, key-value data storage
- [MoQ](https://developers.cloudflare.com/moq/llms.txt): Protocol for live media
- [Pages](https://developers.cloudflare.com/pages/llms.txt): Build full-stack, serverless applications globally with minimal configuration
- [Privacy Pass](https://developers.cloudflare.com/privacy-pass/llms.txt): Privacy Pass tokens let users prove a claim without revealing their identity or being tracked across requests.
- [Privacy Proxy](https://developers.cloudflare.com/privacy-proxy/llms.txt): A MASQUE-based forward proxy that protects user privacy while preserving geolocation accuracy
- [Queues](https://developers.cloudflare.com/queues/llms.txt): Reliably send and receive messages without the egress fees
- [R2](https://developers.cloudflare.com/r2/llms.txt): Store large amounts of unstructured data without egress fees
- [Realtime](https://developers.cloudflare.com/realtime/llms.txt): RealtimeKit, SFU and TURN
- [Sandboxes](https://developers.cloudflare.com/sandbox/llms.txt): Isolated execution on Cloudflare using Containers and Dynamic Workers
- [Stream](https://developers.cloudflare.com/stream/llms.txt): Store, encode, deliver, and play videos on sites and applications
- [Vectorize](https://developers.cloudflare.com/vectorize/llms.txt): Store, query, and manage high-dimensional vector databases
- [Web Search API](https://developers.cloudflare.com/web-search/llms.txt): Ground AI agents and applications with real-time web search results
- [Workers](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/llms.txt): Build, deploy, and scale serverless applications globally with low latency and minimal configuration
- [Workers AI](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers-ai/llms.txt): Run AI models in Workers, Pages, or via API
- [Workers VPC](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers-vpc/llms.txt): Connect Cloudflare Worker's Virtual Private Cloud to your private clouds to build cross-cloud apps.
- [Workflows](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workflows/llms.txt): Build durable, multi-step applications using the Workers platform
- [Zaraz](https://developers.cloudflare.com/zaraz/llms.txt): Run third-party tools and services on the cloud for improved speed and security

## Docs collections

- [Learning Paths](https://developers.cloudflare.com/learning-paths/llms.txt): Guided modules and projects to help you get started with Cloudflare

## Network security

- [BYOIP](https://developers.cloudflare.com/byoip/llms.txt): Get Cloudflare's security and performance while using your own IPs
- [Magic Transit](https://developers.cloudflare.com/magic-transit/llms.txt): Network functions at Cloudflare scale for on-premise, cloud-hosted, and hybrid networks
- [Network Error Logging](https://developers.cloudflare.com/network-error-logging/llms.txt): Review connectivity issues to learn when and where an incident is happening and its impact
- [Network Flow](https://developers.cloudflare.com/network-flow/llms.txt): Visibility into your network and cloud traffic by analyzing network flow data
- [Network Interconnect](https://developers.cloudflare.com/network-interconnect/llms.txt): Faster, more reliable, and more secure than connecting over the Internet

## Other

- [Agent setup](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agent-setup/llms.txt): Install an agent of your choice, connect skills and MCP servers, and start deploying to Cloudflare — all from your editor or terminal.
- [Docs for agents](https://developers.cloudflare.com/docs-for-agents/llms.txt): Learn how AI agents and LLMs consume Cloudflare documentation
- [Migration Guides](https://developers.cloudflare.com/migration-guides/llms.txt): Content designed to help you migrate from another provider to Cloudflare.
- [Security dashboard](https://developers.cloudflare.com/security/llms.txt): Documentation for the Security dashboard with an updated user interface.
- [Style Guide](https://developers.cloudflare.com/style-guide/llms.txt): Style guide to follow for contributing to Cloudflare docs.
- [Use cases](https://developers.cloudflare.com/use-cases/llms.txt): Discover what's possible with Cloudflare.
